title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_11302__PART_1_)
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard ( Part 1 ) specifies general and safety requirements for electro-encephalographs and their associated accessories, intended for the ♦Rules for rounding off numerical values ( revised ). 3 IS: 11302 (Parti) -1985 production of detachable graphic recording of electrical activity of the brain for diagnostic purposes. 1.2 Special requirements concerning other requirements in electroencephalography ( phono-photic stimulators), EEG telemetry, EEG data storage and retrieval, EEG monitoring of the critically ill, etc, are not covered by this standard.

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
